one_line: AI deals surge, regulators act, and security incidents highlight growing ecosystem challenges.

themes.title: AI infrastructure financing expands
themes.text: Thrive Holdings announced a $15.3 billion acquisition of ADT, linking its AI engineering resources with ADT’s security network. Nvidia discussed credit guarantees for a 460 MW data center for Anthropic, committed $3 billion to Meta’s equity offering, and AM Intelligence seeks up to $3 billion to fund Nvidia Vera Rubin chip purchases; Foxconn announced a collaboration with OpenAI, Runware plans a factory to mass‑produce AI pods, and Fujifilm will boost magnetic‑tape production fivefold for AI data archiving.

stories.headline: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings to acquire ADT for $15.3 billion
Nvidia in talks to back Nscale with credit guarantees for Anthropic data center
Nvidia commits $3 billion to Meta share sale and expands AI infrastructure partnership
AM Intelligence seeks up to $3 billion to fund Nvidia Vera Rubin chip purchase
Foxconn says new collaboration with OpenAI in works, denies AI bubble
Runware plans factory to mass‑produce AI pods at car‑assembly line speed
Fujifilm to boost magnetic tape production fivefold as AI drives data archiving

themes.title: Regulators tighten AI oversight
themes.text: London’s High Court dismissed challenges by Meta, TikTok and X to Ofcom’s data‑request notices. The UK Competition and Markets Authority opened a probe into Meta’s terms for publishers and advertisers, while OpenAI announced it will honor a robots.txt signal for training preferences and added expanded safeguards to ChatGPT for violence prevention.

stories.headline: UK high court rejects Meta, TikTok and X challenge to Ofcom data requests
UK competition regulator probes Meta's terms for publishers and advertisers
OpenAI says it will honor robots.txt signal for AI training preferences
OpenAI adds expanded safeguards to ChatGPT for violence prevention

themes.title: AI security incidents rise
themes.text: Chinese state‑linked hackers employed the DeepSeek large language model via the ARTEX framework to breach over 200 organizations in at least 14 countries. A malicious version of Anthropic’s Claude Code VS Code extension attempted to install a persistent SSH backdoor and may have affected up to 5,000 users.

stories.headline: China‑linked hackers used DeepSeek AI via ARTEX to breach 200+ firms in 11 days
Malicious Claude Code VS Code extension adds SSH backdoor, affecting up to 5,000 users
